executiveOverview: Asahi Seika Co., Ltd. (株式会社旭製菓) is a Tokyo-based confectionery maker that has produced karinto, a traditional deep-fried Japanese dough snack, since 1924. It also makes air-popped gourmet popcorn under the Anthony's brand and offers OEM contract manufacturing. Introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), the company is looking for international distributors, importers, specialty food retailers and café operators. Target countries have not yet been fixed and are confirmed during inquiry discussions.

sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: Asahi Seika is seeking partners outside Japan to distribute its karinto snacks and gourmet popcorn. The company's published English page presents two lines: FINGYS, a finger-sized karinto snack in modern flavours, and Anthony's Popcorn, an air-popped, kettle-style popcorn with caramel, chocolate and strawberry coatings.

The company also states that it develops caramel-coated confectionery and other OEM products to a client's request. Partners with a private-label or own-brand programme can raise this in an inquiry. Which countries are open, and on what terms, is discussed after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: About Asahi Seika
paragraphs: According to its company profile, Asahi Seika began making karinto in 1924, was incorporated in 1952, and is headquartered in Nishitokyo, Tokyo. The president's message describes a family business that started with a Yokohama sundries and snack shop and is now led by its fourth-generation president.

The company lists confectionery manufacturing, wholesale, OEM contract manufacturing, direct retail stores, franchise stores, cafés and mail order as its business activities. Its Hanazono plant in Saitama holds FSSC 22000 food safety certification, according to the company's own pages.

sections.heading: Products
paragraphs: Karinto is a cookie-like snack made from fermented wheat flour dough, cut into short sticks, deep-fried and coated with syrup. Asahi Seika describes frying the dough three times and coating it in rotary drums by hand. Its range includes traditional brown sugar karinto, sesame, vegetable and purple sweet potato varieties, and the FINGYS line in Caramel, Coffee and Sweet Potato flavours.

Anthony's Popcorn uses large mushroom-shaped kernels that are air-popped without oil and then coated with syrup cooked in a copper pot. Published flavours include Caramel & Almond, Chocolate & Almond and Strawberry. The company applies its karinto syrup-coating know-how to the popcorn.
Declared allergens vary by product and include wheat, milk, soybeans, sesame and almonds. Full specifications are provided to qualified partners.

sections.heading: International expansion
paragraphs: The company's president states the intention to deliver Asahi Seika's confectionery to customers across Japan and also overseas. The company has published an English-language product and process page. No specific target countries, existing export markets or importers have been published, and none are claimed here.

sections.heading: Ideal partner profile
paragraphs: The company is looking for premium supermarkets, specialty food distributors, importers, café chains and retail operators with experience in premium Asian or gourmet snack categories. Partners should be able to handle import registration, labelling and ambient-temperature distribution in their market, and to present a clear plan for the first twelve months.

sections.heading: Practical considerations
paragraphs: Both karinto and popcorn contain common allergens, and ingredients such as milk, wheat, soybeans, sesame and nuts must be declared according to the rules of the destination market. Importers should check local labelling, additive and import-registration requirements for confectionery before ordering. Shelf life differs by product; the company's domestic specifications list periods of roughly three to six months for karinto, which importers should confirm for export shipments.

sections.heading: Why consider this opportunity
paragraphs: The offer combines a century-old specialist manufacturer, two distinct snack lines suited to premium retail and café channels, and an OEM option for partners that want their own range. Introduction through JIP Japan gives interested partners a single channel for initial qualification and communication with the company.

faqs.answer: Asahi Seika Co., Ltd. (株式会社旭製菓) is a confectionery manufacturer in Nishitokyo, Tokyo. It has made karinto since 1924 and also produces gourmet popcorn.

faqs.answer: Terms are discussed after a qualified inquiry. None are published.
